name: Lai Angesstun

assets.description: Supplied portrait card for Lai Angesstun.

description: Gold dwarf merchant hauling cooking oil and perfume from Amn. Talks frequently about money and is reluctant to spend it on others.
reuseWhen: Use the supplied portrait for appearance continuity. Existing shared artwork depicts the original scene and setting.

appearance.features: Sturdy dwarf with golden hair and a long, elaborately braided golden beard.
appearance.clothing: Gold-trimmed violet coat, cream shirt, patterned red sash, gold jewelry and a carrying rack for bottles and barrels.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Coppercoil asked him about nightglass, which Lai did not recognise.
